items.title: Nanako0129/sepia
items.excerpt: De-AI writing skill for any Agent Skills-compatible agent (77+ via the Skills CLI), with native plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, and Antigravity. Narrative-architecture repair for fiction, venue-matched rules for professional prose. Based on StoryScope (arXiv:2604.03136).
items.summary: De-AI writing skill plugin for 77+ agent frameworks, with narrative repair for fiction and professional prose based on StoryScope research.
items.usefulness: Could help developers build writing-quality enforcement into Python agent tools if the plugin architecture integrates cleanly with your deployment stack.
items.to_verify: Whether the StoryScope arXiv reference (2604.03136) exists and what specific narrative-repair techniques the plugin actually implements.

items.title: Human-Agent-Society/reef
items.excerpt: Continual learning infra for self-improving agents
items.summary: Continual learning infrastructure for self-improving agents, enabling recursive improvement loops without external retraining.
items.usefulness: If you need agents that learn from their own outputs, could reduce operational overhead for document analysis tools that improve accuracy over time.
items.to_verify: What 'continual learning' concretely means here: online fine-tuning, retrieval augmentation, or inference-time adaptation; which models it supports.

items.title: datawhalechina/zero-to-sglang
items.excerpt: Official SGLang x Datawhale course on LLM inference: understand inference, build a mini-sglang from scratch, then read the real SGLang source and land your first PR. Available in English and Chinese.
items.summary: Official SGLang and Datawhale course teaching LLM inference fundamentals, building a mini-SGLang implementation, then reading production source and contributing patches.
items.usefulness: If building Python inference tools, this structured pathway from theory to code to real repository contributions teaches systems thinking applicable to document processing pipelines.
items.to_verify: Whether the course materials and mini-sglang implementation are complete and whether 'landing your first PR' is instructional or promotional claim.

economia|asia.summary: US and China made progress on tariff carve-outs and established an AI dialogue ahead of Xi's Washington visit. Negotiations addressed trade and emerging technology cooperation.

economia|asia.summary: Vietnam joined FTSE emerging-market index and expects significant capital inflows. The move reflects growing investor interest in Southeast Asian markets.

economia|europa.summary: ECB announced plans to invest part of its own funds in tokenised securities, with settlement through the Pontes platform. The move supports digital asset infrastructure development.

economia|europa.summary: EU fiscal watchdog questioned enforcement of budget rules on France and Italy. The challenge comes as both indebted nations face critical fiscal policy decisions.

economia|europa.title: German Economy to Gain Momentum Toward Year-End, Bundesbank Says
economia|europa.summary: German economy will lose momentum in Q3 but recover toward year-end due to temporary factors, the Bundesbank said. Recovery expected as headwinds ease.

economia|europa.summary: Irlanda multó a Google con 403 millones de euros por violar normas de protección de datos entre 2018 y 2020. La autoridad concluyó que incumplió en el tratamiento de datos de localización.

economia|america.title: Brazil Economists Lower 2026 Selic Forecast Following Rate Cut
economia|america.summary: Brazilian economists lowered their 2026 year-end forecast for the benchmark interest rate. The reduction reflects expectations of economic cooling before next month's election.

economia|america.summary: Patria Investments and Ashmore Colombia sold one of Colombia's largest solar parks to power generator Isagen SA. The transaction marks a major renewable energy portfolio shift.

politica|asia.summary: Xi Jinping will meet Trump in Washington this week following May talks in Beijing and before November's Apec summit in Shenzhen. Summit success depends on follow-up actions.

politica|europa.summary: Far-right AfD's rise in German regional elections concerns EU partners, fueling distrust and fear among neighboring nations. Germany's inward turn worries Europe.

politica|europa.title: Trump to meet Macron in New York on sidelines of UN General Assembly
politica|europa.summary: Trump scheduled to meet Macron in New York on the sidelines of UN General Assembly at 5:35 pm. Meeting reflects ongoing bilateral engagement.
